section.30: Divination and Omens (Kitab Al-Kahanah Wa Al-Tatayyur)

30.name_native: Divination and Omens (Kitab Al-Kahanah Wa Al-Tatayyur)

hadiths.text: Narrated Abu Hurairah:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: There is no infection, no hamah, no other promising rain, and no serpent in a hungry belly
